heading: How much waste is recycled across Europe?
subheading: In 2024, 1,827 kg of waste per person were recycled in the EU, up 0.9% from 1,811 kg in 2022. Estonia recorded the highest figure at 6,808 kg per capita, while Ireland had the lowest 2024 value at 393 kg.
textNote: This map visualizes the recycled amount of non-hazardous and hazardous waste in kilograms per capita.
